title.narrative: Scaling up the response to the HIV epidemic through strengthening national capacities and prevention and treatment services for most at risk population - Azerbaijan (01-Jul-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Azerbaijan, HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan (MOH Azerbaijan)This program has the following goals: To reduce HIV prevalence among key affected populations and AIDS related mortality in Azerbaijan through improving access of key affected populations to essential HIV prevention, diagnostic, treatment, care and support services.. The objectives of this program are: To implement evidence-based preventive activities focused on key affected populations. To ensure universal access to comprehensive HIV treatment, care and support. To create enabling environment and ensure program sustainability
